hero.lede: Incepted in the mid-90s, Silicom Electronics Pvt. Ltd. has grown into a pioneering name in the distribution of high-quality test & measurement instruments and electronic components — supporting R&D, QA and production teams across the country.

why.heading: A distribution partner that knows the engineering side of the desk.

items.title: 30+ years in market
items.text: Established relationships with manufacturing & engineering organizations across India — built one delivery, one demo, one lab visit at a time.

items.title: Direct EMS access
items.text: Direct engagement with EMS companies, automotive electronics suppliers, telecom equipment manufacturers and industrial electronics firms.

items.title: Manufacturing cluster presence
items.text: Active sales coverage across NCR, Baddi, Haridwar, Roorkee and the surrounding industrial belt — where the work actually gets built.

items.title: Production-line experience
items.text: Portfolio includes custom test systems for transformer manufacturing, cable harness testing and electronics assembly — not just bench instruments.

items.title: Technical sales support
items.text: Dedicated technical sales engineers who can run a demo on-site, talk through application notes, and answer the awkward measurement question.

items.title: Tender & institutional access
items.text: Strong experience with government institutions, PSUs and research labs through tender procurement — active on GeM since inception.

journey.heading: From a single-brand distributor to a multi-division supply partner.

rows.title: Silicom Electronics is incepted in New Delhi
rows.text: A small distribution office in Kirti Nagar, set up to bring quality test instruments and components to local manufacturers.

rows.title: Authorized distribution for global T&M brands
rows.text: Tektronix, then Microtest and others — Silicom becomes the go-to partner for oscilloscopes, hipot & transformer testers in North India.

rows.title: Components division spins up
rows.text: Adding semiconductors, MOSFETs, diodes, TVS, MLCCs and protection devices — a second division supporting EMS and automotive electronics customers.

rows.title: ISO 9001:2015 certified · GeM assessed
rows.text: Process compliance for institutional and PSU customers. Active on the Government e-Marketplace platform since its inception.

rows.title: EV, GaN & SiC focus
rows.text: Expanding the components portfolio with wide-bandgap power, EV-specific fuses and chargers — supporting India's electrification push.

rows.title: Authorized brand partners · pan-India coverage
rows.text: Two specialised divisions, 20+ employees, and a technical sales force covering the North India electronics belt and key clusters in the South.

people.name: Mr. Suneet Dargan
people.bio: Heads the components division — sourcing semiconductors, passives and protection devices from leading global manufacturers and supporting EMS & automotive customers across North India.

people.name: Mr. Chandeep Singh
people.bio: Heads the instruments division — running technical sales for Tektronix, Microtest, UNI-T and Scientific, with a focus on R&D labs, PSU tenders and production-line test systems.

offer.heading: Helping international brands establish & expand in India.

items.title: Strong relationships across electronics manufacturing
items.text: Silicom represents leading global brands. With strong relationships across electronics manufacturing companies, engineering teams and research institutions, we help international manufacturers establish and expand their presence in the Indian electronics market.

items.title: India-based sales engineers, on call
items.text: Our India-based technical sales team supports partners through product demonstrations, application guidance and engagement with engineering and production teams — enabling effective adoption of new technologies across R&D labs and manufacturing environments.

items.title: Built-in industry access
items.text: We work with electronics manufacturing services companies, automotive electronics suppliers, telecom equipment manufacturers, power electronics companies and research institutions — supporting both engineering development and production testing applications.

items.title: GeM-listed since inception
items.text: Strong experience working with government institutions, PSUs and research laboratories through tender-based procurement. We are GeM assessed and have been active on the Government e-Marketplace platform since its inception.

cta.heading: Let's collaborate.
cta.text: Whether you're a manufacturer evaluating instruments or a global brand exploring the Indian market — we'd love to hear from you.
